limit: Security deposit must not exceed three times the monthly rent, unless otherwise agreed. Refund must be made when the landlord takes possession of the vacant premises, after deducting tenant liabilities.
At least 24 hours written notice. Notice must specify the reason, day and time. Entry must be between 7 AM and 8 PM.
Must not intentionally or negligently damage the premises, must notify the landlord of damage as soon as possible, and must take reasonable care of the premises.
Must provide one original signed and registered tenancy agreement to the tenant within 15 days of its registration with the Rent Authority.

Tenant must pay rent within the period specified in the agreement. Landlord or property manager must provide a written receipt forthwith against acknowledgement. Bank acknowledgement is proof of electronic payment.
